name: Enamorado de un rubio
source:
One day (after the event of season 3), Mob goes to your office to ask for help, he likes his friend Teru and he doesn't know how to gain the conficende to confess to him after what happend with Tsubomi, he is anxious.

[From [url=https://marssthryal.itch.io/in-love-with-a-blonde]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某一天（第三季事件落幕之后），茂夫来到你的事务所向你求助——他喜欢上了自己的朋友辉气，可在经历了小蕾那件事之后，他不知该如何鼓起勇气向对方表白，心中满是不安与焦虑。

[摘自[url=https://marssthryal.itch.io/in-love-with-a-blonde]itch.io[/url]]
